market_summary: Late New York session trading is characterized by broad consolidation and drying liquidity across all assets. Across FX and metals (EURUSD, GBPUSD, XAUUSD, XAGUSD) as well as BTCUSD, prices remain suppressed below their respective daily VWAPs and EMA50 baselines, yet lack the RVOL expansion or momentum needed to drive further downside continuation. US100 remains trapped between EMA50 support and the Gamma Flip/EMA20 ceiling within a negative GEX regime. With sub-1.0 RVOL and compression near key session supports and POC magnets, capital preservation dictates holding flat across the entire basket.
